The series is trend-dominated with high predictability; a simple mean over the full pool may capture the trend without overfitting the few validation windows.

test a dba strategy on a smaller correlated‑error pool (pool1) to see if reducing redundancy helps trend‑dominated series.

Test a weighted combination on the small, diverse pool1 using softmax_neg_error weights to see if a different weighting scheme improves over inverse_error.

The series is trend-dominated with high predictability and moderate ranking stability; a simple mean over a small correlated-error pool (pool1) may reduce variance.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.098. Series context: trend strength 0.9983 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.454); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 38.51.
